tab_storm
‘ptotC’ = Stationary conditions / Control Climate

‘ptotS’ = Step Change (increase/decrese) in observed wetness ‘ptotT’ = Progressive Trend (positive/negative) in observed wetness

‘stormsC’ = Stationary conditions / Control Climate ‘stormsS’ = Step Change (increase/decrese) in observed storminess’ ‘stormsT’ = Progressive Trend (positive/negative) in observed storminess’

‘n/a’ = scenario NOT DEFINED (as both xxx_SC & xxx_SF differ from 0)

finds roots for the passed equation.

cuwalid.storm.rainfall module

cuwalid.storm.rainfall.base_round(stamps, **kwargs)[source]

rounds numbers or time.stamps to either floor or nearest specific T_RES/base.

Input -> stamps : np.array; float numpy (also representing seconds since some origin).

**kwargs -> base : int; rounding (temporal) resolution. time_tag : char; string indicating the base resolution. time_dic : dic; dictionary containing the equivalences of ‘tags’ in base 60. base_system: int; conversion constant for the time_dic-system (default: 60). method : char; rounding method (either ‘floor’ or ‘nearest’). round : int; significative digits/places for rounding.

Output -> rounded numpy (to custom resolution/base, i.e., T_RES).

cuwalid.storm.rainfall.construct_pdfs(pdframe, **kwargs)[source]

sets up and fills the global key pdf-parameters for STORM to work.

Input -> pdframe : pd.DataFrame; dataframe with tabulated pdf-parameters.

**kwargs -> tactic : int; strategy to compute STORM (1 via BETPAR; else via COPxxx).

Output: None.

cuwalid.storm.rainfall.copula_sampling(copula, dist_one, dist_two, **kwargs)[source]

samples randomly (n-size) from a copula, conditional to two distros.

Input -> copula : dict; contains a np.float (i.e., rho) per elevation band dist_one : dict; contains a scipy.stats (pdf) frozen infrastructure dist_two : dict; contains a scipy.stats (pdf) frozen infrastructure.

**kwargs -> band : char; key (of the ‘qant’ dictionary) addressing the frozen pdf. n : int; numbers of (random) samples.

Output -> tuple; containing np.floats for dist_one-samples (first) and dist_two-samples (last).

cuwalid.storm.rainfall.faster_sampling(distro, **kwargs)[source]

faster sampling (truncated or not) preserving the n-requested.

Input -> distro : dict; contains a scipy.stats (pdf) frozen infrastructure.

**kwargs -> limits : tuple; variable limits to sample within. band : char; key (of the ‘distro’ dictionary) addressing the frozen pdf. n : int; numbers of (random) samples.

Output -> np.array of floats with n-samples.

cuwalid.storm.rainfall.last_ring(radii, centres, **kwargs)[source]

creates a circular polygon of given radius and center.

Input -> radii : numpy; float numpy of storm-radius (in km). centres : numpy; 2D-numpy with the X-Y’s of storm centers.

**kwargs -> scaling_dis : float; scaling factor between radius-units and m (1000m==1km). base_radius : float; minimum (base) radius (in km). nonsense : int; factor to tailor-suit the segment resolution.

Output -> geopandas.GeoDataFrame with circular polygons of storm-max-radii.

cuwalid.storm.rainfall.loop(train, mask_shp, np_mask, nsim, simy, nreg, mlen, upd_max, maxima, date_pool)[source]

calls children-functions to compute storms until seasonal rain is reached.

Input -> train : float; total seasonal rainfall to reach. mask_shp : pd.Series; pandas series with GEOMETRY. np_mask : numpy; 2D-numpy with 1’s representing the rain-region. nreg : int; rain-region index. nsim : int; index/ordinal indicating the simulation. simy : int; index/ordinal indicating the year under simulation. mlen : int; number of months in the season upd_max : float; maximum rainfall intensity (mm/h) allowed. maxima : int; maximum value (in RAINFMT) (to clip uX-integers). date_pool : list of start & end ‘datetime.datetime(s)’ of the season.

**kwargs -> Output -> tuple; xarray with seasonal rainfal for a region (first); xarray with total rainfall per time-step (second); float indicating the seasonal total reached (third).

cuwalid.storm.rainfall.lotr(radius, decay, i0, lapse, centre, **kwargs)[source]

creates circular rain.rings evenly spaced from the storm.centre outwards.

Input -> radius : numpy; float numpy of storm-radius (in km). decay : numpy; float numpy of radial-decay (in 1/km). i0 : numpy; float numpy of maximum storm intesity (in mm/h). lapse : numpy; float numpy of the actual raining time-lapse (in h). centre : numpy; 2D-numpy with the X-Y of storm center.

**kwargs -> scaling_dis : float; scaling factor between radius-units and m (1000m==1km). res : int; number of segments in which a circle.quadrant is divided into. dot_size : float; circle’s radius emulating the storm centre’s point/dot. sep_ring : float; separation (in km) between rainfall rings.

Output -> geopandas.GeoDataFrame with linestings of circular.rain from centre.

cuwalid.storm.rainfall.moving_storm(dir_par, vel_par, stridin, centres, **kwargs)[source]

samples storm direction and velocity; and moves storm initial centres along.

Input -> dir_par : dic; vonMises-Fisher mixture-parameters for storm-direction. vel_par : dict; contains a scipy.stats (pdf) frozen infrastructure. stridin : list; numpys list with time-quantization per storm. centres : numpy; 2D-numpy with the X-Y’s of storm initial centers.

**kwargs -> speed_lim : tuple; variable limits to sample within. speed_stat : char; numpy stat to apply to an array.

Output -> (list of?) 2D-numpy array of X-Y’s displaced/moved storm centres.

Output (sets up the following globals) -> SCL : float; multiplicative scaling factor. ADD : float; additive scaling factor. MINIMUM : int; minimum integer allowed. iMAX: float; maximum allowed float (for rainfall).

Input -> nc : char; output path of nc-file. iyear : int; subgroup name representing the simulated year times : np.array; integer array with times (in minutes) since some origin. tag_y : char; coords-attribute in the Y-axis. tag_x : dict; coords-attribute in the X-axis.

cuwalid.storm.rainfall.quantum_time(doy_par, tod_par, DUR_S, date_pool, n)[source]

samples datetimes and quatize them into packs of storm duration(s).

Input -> doy_par : dic; vonMises-Fisher mixture-parameters for Day-of-Year. tod_par : dic; vonMises-Fisher mixture-parameters for Time-of-Day. DUR_S : np.array; float numpy of storm durations (in hours). date_pool : list of start & end ‘datetime.datetime(s)’ of the season. n : int; sample size.

Output -> tuple; list-quatized hourly resolutions & their xploded equivalent (date)times.

cuwalid.storm.rainfall.rain_cube(c_ring, last_r, t_stamp, np_mask, **kwargs)[source]

creates a rainfall cube (potentially) with regional rain already achieved.

Input -> c_ring : tuple; geopandas.GeoDataFrame linerings geometry with rain. last_r : tuple; pandas.Series; polygon geometry with outermost (rain) ring. t_stamp : list; numpy integers representing time-steps since origin. np_mask : numpy; 2D-numpy with 1’s representing the rain-region.

**kwargs -> space : class; class where spatial variables are defined. max_val : float; maximum value for rainfall allowed.

Output -> tuple; xarray.DataArray(s) with rounded rainfall (first) and total rainfall (within n-region) for every time-stamp (last).
